# Sri Sai Dhanada Enterprises (SSD Enterprises)

> Sri Sai Dhanada Enterprises, widely known as SSD Enterprises, is a professional debt-recovery and collections agency headquartered in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. It serves Banks and NBFCs through 10 offices across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Odisha. Experience dates back to 2006 under the name SR Enterprises; SSD Enterprises was formally established in 2021.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Sri Sai Dhanada Enterprises (proprietorship firm); also known as SSD Enterprises
- Head office: D.No. 39-11-5, Sri Srinivasa Towers, AXIS Bank Upstairs, 4th Floor, Murali Nagar, Visakhapatnam - 530007, Andhra Pradesh
- Offices: Visakhapatnam (Head Office and Madhavadhara II), Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore, Kadapa, Secunderabad, Warangal, Karimnagar, Bhubaneswar
- Contact: S. Govinda Rao, +91 92908 65555, ssdenterprisesvizag@gmail.com
- Customers: Banks and NBFCs (agency empanelment enquiries accepted at the head office)

## Services
- Collections & Debt Recovery: credit cards, personal loans, business loans and consumer durable loans; delinquency buckets from early stage through 180+ DPD and written-off pools; tele-calling and field collections
- Verifications & Skip Tracing: physical and tele address verification, KYC validation, skip tracing and trace reports
